# SN Cleaning Services

> SN Cleaning Services is a domestic cleaning company based in Brentwood, Essex, cleaning homes for 12 years and managed by Silvia Nedeva. Its own trained, insured and DBS checked cleaners do end of tenancy, deep, regular domestic, Airbnb, after builders, carpet, upholstery and mattress cleaning in homes across all of London inside the M25 and all of Essex. Rated 5.0 on Google.

Last updated: 18 November 2026

## Services and from prices
Every price is a "from" price. The exact price comes through Get a quote on the website, based on the size of the home and what the customer chooses.
- [End of tenancy cleaning](https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/end-of-tenancy-cleaning/): from £179, depending on bedrooms, bathrooms and extras. [London](https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/end-of-tenancy-cleaning/london/), [Essex](https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/end-of-tenancy-cleaning/essex/)
- [Domestic cleaning](https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/domestic-cleaning/): from £23 per hour, minimum 3 hours a visit, cleaning products provided. [London](https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/domestic-cleaning/london/), [Essex](https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/domestic-cleaning/essex/)
- [Deep cleaning](https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/deep-house-cleaning/): from £27 per hour, quoted per home. Inside the oven only when the customer adds it. [London](https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/deep-house-cleaning/london/), [Essex](https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/deep-house-cleaning/essex/)
- [Airbnb cleaning](https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/airbnb-cleaning/): from £25 per hour (£26 per hour for a single property, £25 per hour when we clean several properties for the same host), changeovers between guests. [London](https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/airbnb-cleaning/london/), [Essex](https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/airbnb-cleaning/essex/)
- [After builders cleaning](https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/after-builders-cleaning/): from £179. [London](https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/after-builders-cleaning/london/), [Essex](https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/after-builders-cleaning/essex/)
- [Carpet cleaning](https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/carpet-cleaning-services/): from £49. [London](https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/carpet-cleaning-services/london/), [Essex](https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/carpet-cleaning-services/essex/)
- [Upholstery cleaning](https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/upholstery-cleaning/): from £69. [Essex](https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/upholstery-cleaning/essex/)
- [Mattress cleaning](https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/mattress-cleaning/): from £39. [Essex](https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/mattress-cleaning/essex/)
- Office, school and nursery cleaning is done by the sister company at https://snclean.co.uk/, not by SN Cleaning Services.

## End of tenancy cleaning in detail
- Included: every room top to bottom, inside all kitchen cupboards and drawers, fridge and freezer, hob, extractor and microwave, bathrooms descaled, internal glass, skirting boards, doors, switches and radiators, carpets vacuumed and hard floors washed. A checklist for every room.
- Optional extras: oven cleaning (professional internal kitchen appliance cleaning, priced by oven size) and professional carpet cleaning. The oven is not included in the from price.
- Not included: outside windows and washing whole walls (marks are removed where possible).
- Show up guarantee: the clean happens on the booked day. If something outside the company's control happens, it is done within 12 hours or it is free.
- Deposit back guarantee: covers everything related to the cleaning that was booked. If the letting agent or landlord says an area is not clean enough, the team comes back and cleans it free. It cannot cover services that were not booked, such as professional carpet cleaning.
- A receipt or cleaning certificate is given for the letting agent.
- Keys: collected and returned free within one mile of the property, £15 up to three miles, £25 up to five miles.
- Payment: card details are added at booking, the amount is held on the card 48 hours before the clean, and the card is charged once the job is done. No pay after the job.
- Before the team arrives: electricity on, boiler working for hot water, fridge and freezer switched off. The property should be empty of belongings; the customer does not need to be there.
- Usually 3 to 6 hours for the team, depending on size. Same day and weekend cleans are possible. Booked by tenants, landlords and letting agents.
- The law: since the Tenant Fees Act 2019 a landlord in England cannot make a tenant pay for a professional clean, but the home must be returned as clean as at check in, allowing for fair wear and tear. Deposit disputes go to the deposit protection schemes (DPS, mydeposits, TDS).

## Re clean guarantee
- Free re clean if anything is missed: 7 days for empty properties (end of tenancy, and after builders cleaning when nobody lives there), 24 hours for homes people live in (domestic, deep, Airbnb, carpet, upholstery, mattress).
- Report it in the customer app or on WhatsApp, ideally with photos. The team aims to come back within 1 to 2 working days, often within 24 hours.

## How SN Cleaning Services works
- Every cleaner is SN Cleaning Services' own trained, insured and DBS checked team member, never a subcontractor.
- Professional products and equipment, including its own Limescale Remover.
- A checklist for every room. Regular visits also cover what is often skipped: under sofa cushions, moving small furniture, under rugs.
- No judgement: whatever state a home is in, the team is there to help.

## Customer support
- Online booking any time; a customer account is created automatically with the first booking.
- WhatsApp and website chat: Monday to Friday 7am to 10pm, Saturday and Sunday 8am to 5pm.
- Email and app messages: Monday to Friday 9am to 5pm, answered within 1 hour (usually 15 to 20 minutes).
- Phone team: Monday to Friday 9am to 5pm. An AI phone assistant answers 24 hours (prices, availability, bookings).
- Details: https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/contact/

## What SN Cleaning Services does not offer
- Office, school, nursery or other commercial cleaning (see SN Clean)
- Cleaning in Kent
- Outside windows on end of tenancy cleans
- Washing whole walls
- An oven clean included in the end of tenancy price
- Pay after the job
